description: A record of a petition/comment submission (ADR-2605312400 §3, moushibumi_submit). Two `mode`s: `member-self-submit` (default, R2 — moushibumi assembled + handed back, the member filed) and `agent-on-behalf` (代行, R3 GATED — moushibumi filed the member's OWN voice via the official channel). CONSTITUTIONAL: `agent-on-behalf` is permitted ONLY when the target is `council-verified` (G14), per-submission consent is recorded, and the R3 gate (行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+) is satisfied (G15); only external mutation is a lawful submission via an official channel with member authorization (G10); member is the named 請願者/意見提出者 (G4); no platform-held signing key (ADR-2605231525). Holds submission metadata + pointers, never inline content (G6). NEVER applies to election-info (INFO-ONLY, G3).

memberDid.description: The 請願者/意見提出者本人 (G4)

draftRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the voiceDraft submitted

mode.description: G15 — member-self-submit is the default; agent-on-behalf (代行) is the GATED R3 exception

consentRef.description: Per-submission consent artifact (G4; mandatory for agent-on-behalf, G15)

councilGateRef.description: For mode=agent-on-behalf: reference to the on-chain Council Lv7+ + 行政書士法 clearance gate (G15). Absent ⇒ agent-on-behalf is invalid.

receiptRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the submission receipt / 受付番号 (G6)
